main.description: Lists the label values declared by the current issuance policy, optionally with their state for a target.

reason.description: An optional explanation for inspecting the issuance policy.

target.description: Optionally inspect current label state for an account DID or handle, or a record AT URI.

cid.description: An optional record version; requires a record AT URI target.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The optional target or content version is malformed.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The authenticated caller does not have permission to inspect labels.

errors.name: PolicyUnavailable
errors.description: The current issuance policy is unavailable.

errors.name: TargetResolutionFailed
errors.description: The optional account target could not be resolved.

errors.name: TargetNotFound
errors.description: The optional record target could not be found or verified.

errors.name: StorageUnavailable
errors.description: Label state could not be read because storage is unavailable.

errors.name: ServiceUnavailable
errors.description: The labeler service is temporarily unavailable.
